featureFlags.title: Feature Flags
featureFlags.subtitle: Toggle individual features on or off. Changes take effect within 60 seconds.
featureFlags.rowMissing: Row missing — run the 078 migration to seed default flags.
featureFlags.superAdminOnly: Only super_admin accounts can manage feature flags.
featureFlags.safetyWarning: This changes a rental safety requirement.
featureFlags.desc.form_memory: Remember recent form entries (address/project/contact) in localStorage.
featureFlags.desc.today_dashboard: Deliveries / returns / starts / ends scheduled today.
featureFlags.desc.utilization_dashboard: Fleet utilization report with filters and charts.
featureFlags.desc.audit_log_search: Filterable audit log with JSON diff viewer (super_admin only).
featureFlags.desc.rental_duplicate: Duplicate an existing rental into a new draft.
featureFlags.desc.conflict_warning: Realtime availability conflict banner in rental form.
featureFlags.desc.rental_renewal: One-click renewal extending a completed rental.
featureFlags.desc.late_fee_auto: Automatic late fee line items on invoices.
featureFlags.desc.credit_limit: Customer blacklist + credit limit enforcement on new rentals.
featureFlags.desc.birthday_greetings: Automated birthday and holiday greeting emails.
featureFlags.desc.signature_evidence: Capture IP + user agent + document hash at signing time.
featureFlags.desc.mid_rental_swap: Replace a broken-down unit on an active/overdue order — old unit to maintenance, optional charge / repair work order / dispatch.
featureFlags.desc.rolling_renewal_operat: Confirm open-ended renewals, settle every 28 days, and track per-unit return progress.
featureFlags.desc.dispatch_workflow: Create and enforce delivery and pickup dispatch orders.
featureFlags.desc.dispatch_inspection_re: Require a dispatch inspection before equipment enters rental service.
featureFlags.desc.return_inspection_requ: Require a return inspection before completing each equipment unit.
